title: Reverse the Transmission
story:
A garbled transmission arrived backwards.

Input: one word (letters and digits, 1–100 characters, no spaces).

Output: the word reversed.

Example: `HELLO` prints `OLLEH`.
hints: `strlen(word)` tells you how many characters there are.
The last character is at index `strlen(word) - 1`, the first at 0.
Loop i from `len - 1` down to 0, printing `word[i]` with `%c`, then a new line.
